TO LEAD Y.M.C.A.'s 1965 CAMPAIGN

SSS SF SS SS SS SSS SSS SS SSS SS SS SSS TSS 


Mr. Robert H. Hoppe, President of Stuart Brothers Limited, 
has accepted the General Chairmanship of the Montreal 

Y.M.C.A.'s annual campaign in March, Mr. Hoppe is Chairman 
of the Board of Management of the Downtown Y.M.C.A. and a 


member of the Board of Directors of the Montreal Y.M.C.A. 


Mr. J. Leonard Walker, General Manager, Bank of Montreal, 
will be Chairman of the Special Names Division. 
The appointments were announced récently by Mr, H. Roy 


Crabtree, President of the Montreal Y.M.C.A.
